title: Separate time-based activities in Monthly Volume Summary

requirements.text: Update the Monthly Volume Summary to display Plank and Squash as individual metrics with their own counters — 'Total Plank Time' and 'Total Squash Time' — both expressed in minutes (e.g., '42 min'). Press-ups and Squats must retain their existing 'Total Reps' counters and must not be affected.

quotes: Plank and Squash are displayed as their own individual metrics with their own 'Total Time' counters (e.g., 'Total Plank Time' and 'Total Squash Time')

acceptanceCriteria: Monthly Volume Summary shows a 'Total Plank Time' metric displaying the total plank duration for the selected month in minutes.
Monthly Volume Summary shows a 'Total Squash Time' metric displaying the total squash duration for the selected month in minutes.
Time values are rendered as whole minutes (e.g., '42 min'), not as hours or mixed format.
Press-ups and Squats continue to show 'Total Reps' counters unchanged.
Plank and Squash time metrics are visually distinct from the rep-based metrics (e.g., separate label and unit).
If no Plank or Squash data exists for the selected month, the counter displays 0 min.
Changing the selected month tab updates both time-based and rep-based counters accordingly.

requirements.text: Leave the Yearly Progress chart (YearlyProgressChartSection) completely unchanged — do not modify its data logic, labels, units, colors, or layout.

quotes: On the Yearly Progress chart, keep the same as it already shows plank and squash time separately

acceptanceCriteria: YearlyProgressChartSection renders identically before and after this change.
No modifications are made to YearlyProgressChartSection.tsx or its underlying data aggregation.

constraints: Do not modify YearlyProgressChartSection.tsx or any data logic feeding the Yearly Progress chart.
Do not change how Press-ups and Squats are displayed in the Monthly Volume Summary.
Time values in the Monthly Volume Summary must be displayed in minutes only — no hours or mixed format.
nonGoals: Modifying the Yearly Progress chart in any way.
Adding time-based metrics to the habit grid rows.
Changing the backend data model or storage format.
Supporting hours or mixed time formats in the Monthly Volume Summary.
